lines: Composer; R. J. Stevens
Scripture; 1 Corinthians 14:20
O for a childlike heart in me,
To serve You, Lord, in purity;
And hold Your hand so close each day,
Till I'm called home with You to stay.
The little ones are malice free,
I'll put away all enmity;
With open mind to seek your way,
I'll let Your steps lead ev'ry day.
Their hmble minds speak honestly,
So I will live by Your decree;
To feel for all hurt in life's way,
And love all souls who are lost today.
In childlike trust I come to Thee;
My way, dear Lord, I cannot see.
I'll never fear the unseen way,
My Father will not lead astray.
O for a childlike heart in me
To serve You, Lord, in purity;
Till by Thy grace a crown I'll wear,
Forever in Your love and care.
